# datadog_integration_chatgpt_enterprise_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog ChatGPT Enterprise integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the ChatGPT Enterprise integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the ChatGPT Enterprise integration account.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings configured on the ChatGPT Enterprise integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Optional

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from ChatGPT Enterprise, keyed by dataflow ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `chat_gpt_enterprise_integration_account_bearer_token_auth` (Attributes) The bearer token authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--chat_gpt_enterprise_integration_account_bearer_token_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--chat_gpt_enterprise_integration_account_bearer_token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.chat_gpt_enterprise_integration_account_bearer_token_auth`

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `bearer_token`. Defaults to `"bearer_token"`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Secret token used to authenticate with ChatGPT Enterprise. Exactly one of `token` or `token_wo` must be set. Prefer `token_wo`, which Terraform 1.11+ keeps out of state; this attribute is stored in Terraform state.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret token used to authenticate with ChatGPT Enterprise. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for token_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.



<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `openai_org_id` (String) OpenAI API Platform organization ID (`org-...`) that the Costs API uses for your Enterprise usage. This is not the ChatGPT workspace UUID or your Datadog organization ID. A value that does not match `^org-[A-Za-z0-9]+$` is rejected with a `422` response.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Optional:

- `chatgpt_enterprise_agent_console` (Attributes) Activity, token consumption, credits, and estimated usage costs across ChatGPT Chat, ChatGPT Work, and Codex, shown in Agent Console with breakdowns by product, model, and user where OpenAI provides them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--chatgpt_enterprise_agent_console))
- `chatgpt_enterprise_cloud_cost_data` (Attributes) ChatGPT Enterprise costs from the OpenAI Costs API, which you can analyze in [Cloud Cost Management](https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/). These costs are excluded from Cloud Cost Management spend-monitored billing. Reported costs are estimates, not final invoice amounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--chatgpt_enterprise_cloud_cost_data))

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.
